name: Gentle Glow Foaming Cleanser 150ml
how_to_use: Morning and night on damp skin, massage 30 seconds, rinse.

name: Cream Cloud Hydrating Cleanser 150ml
how_to_use: Morning and night, massage onto dry or damp skin, rinse with lukewarm water.

name: Melt Away Cleansing Balm 100g
how_to_use: At night on dry skin, massage for a minute to melt makeup and sunscreen, add water, rinse. Follow with your usual cleanser.

name: Calm Water Hydrating Toner 200ml
how_to_use: After cleansing, pat a few drops into the skin with your hands, morning and night.

name: Fade Away 5% Glycolic Toner 150ml
how_to_use: At night after cleansing, swipe over the face with a cotton pad, 3 nights a week to start. Don't use on the same night as retinol.
caution: Patch-test first. Always use sunscreen during the day. Stop if it stings for more than a minute.

name: Even Tone Niacinamide 10% Serum 30ml
how_to_use: 3–4 drops after cleansing, morning and night, before moisturiser.
caution: Patch-test first. Mild tingling for the first few days is normal.

name: Clear Path 2% Salicylic Serum 30ml
how_to_use: Every other night after cleansing, then moisturiser. Build up to nightly.
caution: Not for pregnancy. Patch-test first. Always use sunscreen during the day.

name: Bright Days Vitamin C 15% Serum 30ml
how_to_use: 3 drops in the morning after cleansing, then sunscreen.
caution: Patch-test first. Keep the bottle closed and away from heat.

name: Night Renew 0.3% Retinol Serum 30ml
how_to_use: Night only, 2 nights a week to start, after cleansing. Always use sunscreen the next day.
caution: Not for pregnancy or breastfeeding. Patch-test first. Expect some dryness in the first 2 weeks.

name: Deep Drink Hyaluronic Acid Serum 30ml
how_to_use: 3–4 drops on damp skin after cleansing, morning and night, then moisturiser.

name: Even Glow 10% Azelaic Acid Serum 30ml
how_to_use: A thin layer after cleansing, once a day to start, then morning and night. Follow with moisturiser.
caution: Patch-test first. Mild tingling for the first few days is normal.

name: Overnight Spot Patches (36 patches)
how_to_use: On a clean, dry pimple at night. Peel off in the morning.
caution: For surface spots only. Don't use on open wounds or broken skin.

name: Bright Eyes Caffeine Eye Cream 15ml
how_to_use: A rice-sized amount around both eyes, morning and night. Tap in gently with your ring finger.

name: Clay Detox Face Mask 100ml
how_to_use: Once or twice a week on clean skin. Leave for 10 minutes, then rinse with lukewarm water.
caution: Patch-test first. Don't use on the same day as an exfoliating toner.

name: Barrier Balm Ceramide Moisturiser 50ml
how_to_use: Morning and night as the last step before sunscreen.

name: Matte Fresh Gel Moisturiser 50ml
how_to_use: Morning and night after serum.

name: Sheer Shield SPF 50 Sunscreen 50ml (no white cast)
how_to_use: Two finger-lengths every morning as the last step. Reapply every 2–3 hours outdoors.

name: Glow Tint SPF 40 Tinted Sunscreen 50ml (deep shades)
how_to_use: Two finger-lengths every morning as the last step. Blend well. Reapply every 2–3 hours outdoors.

name: Even Tone Body Lotion 400ml
how_to_use: All over the body after a bath, morning and night. Use sunscreen on exposed areas during the day.

name: Cocoa Glow Lip Balm 10g
how_to_use: Apply whenever lips feel dry, and before bed.

name: Starter Routine Set (cleanser, niacinamide serum, gel moisturiser, SPF 50)
how_to_use: Morning: cleanser, serum, moisturiser, SPF. Night: cleanser, serum, moisturiser.

name: Hydration Heroes Set (cream cleanser, hyaluronic serum, ceramide moisturiser)
how_to_use: Morning and night: cleanser, serum on damp skin, then moisturiser. Add sunscreen in the morning.
